title: Continuous Cross Approximation of Matrices Arising Out of Kernel Functions
summary: We propose a residual energy-based framework for constructing low-rank approximations of kernel matrices arising from continuous kernel functions. The method operates in a continuous setting and is based on the adaptive selection of pivot nodes, referred to as \emph{optimal nodes}, which are chosen to minimize the residual energy at each step. This leads to a sequence of rank-$1$ updates of the residual kernel and admits a natural interpretation as a continuous analog of Adaptive Cross Approximation (ACA).
